title: kbsettings.py explain returns the settings file's absolute path as source, and nothing runs kbsettings.py check
goal: kbsettings.py explain gives source as a path relative to the workspace root (no user home path reaches the kb_settings tool's transcript), and kbsettings.py check runs in the doc checks (selfdoc or the sync gate) so the SETTINGS table's doc line numbers cannot drift unnoticed

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, sys, json
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', T])
os.makedirs(os.path.join(T, 'kb', 'team'))
json.dump({'coordination': {'strategy': {'working': 'after'}}}, open(os.path.join(T, 'kb', 'team', 'settings.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'))
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/kbsettings.py', 'explain', 'strategy.working', '--root', T, '--kb-root', 'team', '--json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
try:
    src = json.loads(r.stdout).get('source', '')
except ValueError:
    src = ''
gated = any('kbsettings' in open(p, encoding='utf-8').read() for p in ('_tools/selfdoc.py', '_tools/kg_sync.py') if os.path.exists(p))
ok = r.returncode == 0 and bool(src) and not os.path.isabs(src) and T not in src and gated
print('explain exit', r.returncode, '| source', src[:70], '| kbsettings.py check wired into selfdoc or the sync gate', gated)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
